name: Equipment selection
about: Starter for how one kind of equipment is chosen for a job. Generic headings only: rename, delete and fill them. Everything it adds comes in "to verify".

items.title: Inputs
items.notes: What the selection needs from the job: duties, conditions, space, power, noise, budget, and where each one comes from.

items.title: Rules
items.notes: The limits and rules of thumb that decide a selection, each with its unit and where it comes from.

items.title: Steps
items.notes: The selection in order, one branch per step.

items.title: Software and tools
items.notes: The selection software or calculator used, its version, and what to check in its results.

items.title: Options that change the selection
items.notes: Options that change capacity, size, weight, power or noise, and by how much.

items.title: Checks before quoting
items.notes: What to check before the selection goes to the customer.

items.title: Common mistakes
items.notes: Mistakes seen in selections, one branch each, with how to avoid them.
